query: Premium 100% soy wax candle, eucalyptus and mint, high burn quality, reusable tin.

products.title: Tin Candle
products.description: The Eucalyptus Mint Tin Candle by ScentAir is a hand-poured, small-batch soy blend candle designed to provide a room-filling, professional-quality fragrance. It features an invigorating blend of eucalyptus, spearmint, peppermint, fresh ozone, and clean musk, creating a crisp experience reminiscent of a snowcapped mountain resort. Housed in a decorative gold tin, it is ideal for small to medium rooms and offers a burn time of up to 20 hours.
